gates.p30Check: run paraphrased prompt-summary variants and exact-summary lookup ablation
gates.passCriterion: trained route must not pass solely by exact summary match

gates.p30Check: remove/mask source ids and compare decisions
gates.passCriterion: decision remains based on prompt features, not id

gates.signalBlocked: any local path or repository path lineage

pairId and derived P24/P25/P26 row ids

shuffle rows and verify identical decisions
gates.passCriterion: order shuffle does not change skill choice except stochastic tie metadata

gates.p30Check: permute candidate skill order for every row
gates.passCriterion: selected skill remains stable by meaning

gates.signalBlocked: positive skill index inside candidate list
gates.p30Check: move positive skill to first/middle/last positions
gates.passCriterion: position-only baseline fails and trained decision is invariant
